For the reaction A(g) B(g) the value of the equilibrium constant at 300 K and 1 atm is equal to 100.0. The value of rG for the reaction at 300 K and 1 atm in J mol-1 is – xR, where x is _______. (Rounded off to the nearest integer)
[R = 8.31 J mol–1K-1 and ln 10 = 2.3)
en.explanation:
For a reaction, A(g) B(g)

Given, Kp (equilibrium constant) = 100

Temperature = 300 K

Pressure = 1 atm

Formula used, G = RT ln Kp .... (i)

Here, G = standard Gibb's free energy

R = gas constant = 8.31 J mol1 K1

Put value in Eq. (i), we get

G = R (300) ln 100

G = R (300) (2) ln (10)

ln (10) = 2.3

G = R(300) (2) (2.3)

G = 1380 R

Hence, G = xR

x = 1380
